text:
felix_cs: Harper at Meridian (preview) reported a \"microburst\" after a partner workshop — ~12 new evaluators added simultaneously and 6 are showing \"awaiting invite\" + 2 seeing CLI 401s. They have an exec demo in 72h and are worried about retention. Can we triage and offer a short enablement?

nina_sre: On it. Org MID-778. Do we know if they used CSV bulk invite or SCIM?

felix_cs: They used CSV bulk upload via the UI. Harper says they hit the preview seat cap and then retried a few times.

ops-bot: incident 1820001111 created: label=preview-enroll microburst severity=high

nina_sre: Quick check: `admin seats list --org MID-778 --status pending` -> shows 6 pending. Also token-service logs show 401 for two distinct API keys. Hypothesis: cap enforcement + key binding race.

deploy-bot: deploy 1820001150: hotfix/queue-dedupe rolled to prod-canary

nina_sre: Applied a short queue-debounce and temporarily bumped quota to avoid further failures: `quotas override MID-778 80 --reason \"partner-workshop microburst\"`. Requeued 6 invites; should deliver in ~5min. Rotated affected keys for 2 users and emailed temps. Logs:
```
2024-08-04T10:03:12Z seats: pending=6
2024-08-04T10:03:42Z quota: override applied by nina_sre
2024-08-04T10:04:05Z invites: 6 requeued -> delivered
2024-08-04T10:05:01Z keys: rotated for cindy@meridian.com,dave@meridian.com
```

omar_enable: I can run a focused 20m enablement session tomorrow 9:00am PT (recorded). Plan: 1) confirm who got access, 2) quick CLI token + retry flow (5m), 3) invite/role checklist, 4) 3-question feedback pulse.

harper_customer: 9:00am PT works. We also want a one-pager for execs explaining what happened and any impact on data or demos.

felix_cs: I'll draft a customer remediation note: root cause (bulk upload + cap race), actions taken (temporary quota bump, invite requeue, key rotation), and mitigation (runbook + monitor). Will include the one-pager and feedback link.

ops-bot: crm 1820001200: renewal_risk=medium flagged for MID-778 by felix_cs; link=https://sf.redwood/opp/778

omar_enable: Agenda + meeting link will be posted in 30m. I'll attach the recording and extract feedback summary. Pulse questions: \"ease of access\", \"confidence to demo\", \"recommend Redwood\" (1-5).

nina_sre: Monitoring metrics now: invite delivery success -> 100%, token 401 rate down to baseline. Will remove quota override in 12h after stability check.

harper_customer: Invites came through, CLI auth working for rotated keys. Appreciate the fast help. We'll join 9:00 session.

felix_cs: Action recap:
- nina_sre: add microburst detection to the preview oncall playbook + remove override after stability window
- omar_enable: run 9:00am PT recorded enablement + share one-pager and pulse link
- felix_cs: send remediation note and paste SFDC link + feedback summary after session

harper_customer: Submitted pulse after the session: ease=5, confidence=4, recommend=5, comment=\"Quick response saved our demo. One-pager was perfect for execs.\"

felix_cs: Thanks team  will mark this resolved and attach meeting recording + feedback snippet to the account. Closing loop in SFDC. :tada:
